window-1.title: Max Bittker's Projects
window-1.blurb: This is the whole toybox of the guy who made river.maxbittker.com — falling-sand worlds, generative gardens, tiny strange tools — and I think you'll fall down it for an hour and come out with three new side quests.

window-3.title: Chrysanthemum Osmanthus Citrus Sparkler
window-3.blurb: It's your grandma's dried-flower tea jar turned into a golden, fizzy spritz — heritage flavors you already know by heart, dressed up enough to photograph.

window-4.title: The Modern House — Journal
window-4.blurb: Every home in here treats a lifetime of accumulated stuff as the actual decor — books on the floor, one perfect lamp, zero styling — which is permission to let all your side-quest objects live out in the open instead of in bins.

window-5.title: Mad Roaster's Slow Bar, Enabling Village
window-5.blurb: A slow bar buried inside Enabling Village, run by a team that hires refugees and pours coffee like it's a ritual — exactly the kind of place you'd sit in for three hours, sketch something, and end up befriending the barista.
